meta.name: deployment-patterns
meta.description: Deployment workflows, CI/CD pipeline patterns, Docker containerization, health checks, rollback strategies, and production readiness checklists for web applications. Use when setting up deployment infrastructure or planning releases.

copy.tagline: 搭建部署流水线，实现自动化发布与回滚
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为Web应用配置CI/CD和容器化部署
copy.tagline_en: Set up deployment pipelines for automated releases and rollbacks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure CI/CD and containerized deployment for web apps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你设计部署流程、编写 Dockerfile、配置 CI/CD 流水线、设置健康检查、制定回滚策略，并检查生产就绪清单。
howto.when: 当你询问如何设置 CI/CD 流水线、容器化应用、规划部署策略（如蓝绿部署、金丝雀部署）或准备生产发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Node.js 的多阶段 Dockerfile。
如何为我的应用设置蓝绿部署？
say.note: Claude 会解释蓝绿部署的步骤和优缺点。

say.text: 给我一个生产就绪检查清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design deployment workflows, write Dockerfiles, configure CI/CD pipelines, set up health checks, define rollback strategies, and review production readiness checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, planning deployment strategies (e.g., blue-green, canary), or preparing for a production release.

say_en.text: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for Node.js.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Dockerfile with dependency, build, and runtime stages.

say_en.text: How do I set up blue-green deployment?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the steps and trade-offs of blue-green deployment.

say_en.text: Give me a production readiness checklist.
